app_info.subtitle: Notes and UML diagrams
app_info.description: Pamiac keeps one person's notes and UML diagrams. ChatGPT can search that private library, open a document, create a note or diagram, and update what is already there.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the signed-in account id and the name or email when the account has them, and does not change the account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only this private Pamiac account and does not post, send, or publish anything.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches this account's notes and diagrams and does not create or edit them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Searches only this private library, not the public web or another service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists this account's notes and diagrams and does not change them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Lists only documents in this private account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one note or diagram in this account and does not change it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only a document in this private account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new markdown note in this account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only inside this private account and does not publish the note.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new note and does not delete or overwrite an existing document.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new UML diagram in this account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only inside this private account and does not publish the diagram.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new diagram and does not delete or overwrite an existing document.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the markdown of a note in this account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates only a note in this private account and does not publish it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces the note's full markdown, and the previous text is not kept.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes nodes and relations on a diagram in this account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates only a diagram in this private account and does not publish it.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite element fields and delete nodes or relations, and the previous diagram is not kept.

test_cases.description: Search the private library for a topic.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find my notes about checkout payments.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching notes and diagrams with titles, links, and excerpts.

test_cases.description: Open one document from the library.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open my Checkout note and show me the text.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns that note's title, markdown, and link.

test_cases.user_prompt: Save a note titled Packing list with milk, bread, and eggs.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the note and returns its title, markdown, and link.

test_cases.user_prompt: Draw a class diagram with Order and Payment, where Order charges Payment.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the diagram and returns its nodes, the charges relation, and a link.

test_cases.description: Add a method on an existing diagram.
test_cases.user_prompt: On my Checkout diagram, add pay(): void to the Order class.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates that class and returns the diagram with the new method.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email my Checkout note to the finance team.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot send email.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not search the public web.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the web for UML composition examples.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only searches this private library.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not read a calendar.
